WITH temp_table AS (
SELECT #{glueAreaMachine.mixArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR} mix_area, #{glueAreaMachine.glue,jdbcType=VARCHAR} glue FROM dual
) SELECT MIX_AREA, GLUE, ifnull(SAFE_STOCK, 0) SAFE_STOCK, ifnull(RESERVE_STOCK_RATE, 0) as RESERVE_STOCK_RATE FROM T_GLUE_SAFE_STOCK WHERE DEL_FLAG= '0'
AND (MIX_AREA, GLUE) IN (SELECT MIX_AREA, GLUE FROM temp_table)

SELECT STOCK_DATE, MIX_AREA, GLUE, ifnull(sum(STOCK_NUM), 0) STOCK_NUM, ifnull(sum(STOCK_WEIGHT), 0) STOCK_WEIGHT FROM T_GLUE_STOCK WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND STOCK_DATE = #{planDate} AND MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} GROUP BY STOCK_DATE, MIX_AREA, GLUE

SELECT mix_area,GLUE, machine_code, sum(ifnull(NIGHT_PLAN_QTY,0)) as DAY_PLAN_QTY, max(FORMULA_WEIGHT) as formula_weight FROM T_GLUE_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE del_flag ='0' AND schedule_date = #{planDate} AND mix_area = #{mixArea} AND NIGHT_PLAN_QTY > 0 group by mix_area, glue, machine_code
SELECT mix_area, GLUE, ifnull(sum(TOTAL_PLAN_QTY), 0) as SHELF_NUM FROM T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN WHERE mix_area = #{mixArea} AND plan_date = #{planDate} AND del_flag = '0' group by mix_area, glue

WITH temp_table AS (
SELECT #{glueAreaMachine.mixArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR} mix_area, #{glueAreaMachine.glue,jdbcType=VARCHAR} glue FROM dual
) SELECT STOCK_DATE, MIX_AREA, GLUE, ifnull(sum(STOCK_NUM), 0) STOCK_NUM, ifnull(sum(STOCK_WEIGHT), 0) STOCK_WEIGHT FROM T_ML_GLUE_STOCK WHERE DEL_FLAG= '0' AND STOCK_DATE = DATE_SUB(#{planDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) /*排程日期 要减1天，才是对应库存日期*/
AND (MIX_AREA, GLUE) IN (SELECT MIX_AREA, GLUE FROM temp_table)
GROUP BY STOCK_DATE, MIX_AREA, GLUE

SELECT MIX_AREA, /*密炼区*/ GLUE, /*胶料名称*/ ifnull(sum(NIGHT_PLAN_QTY), 0) as DAY_PLAN_QTY FROM T_GLUE_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_SUB(#{planDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) /*昨日排程*/ AND MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' group by MIX_AREA, GLUE

SELECT MIX_AREA, GLUE, ifnull(sum(FINISH_QTY), 0) as FINISH_QTY FROM T_GLUE_PART_FINISH WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_SUB(#{planDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) /*昨日排程*/ group by MIX_AREA, GLUE

WITH temp_table AS (
SELECT #{areaMaterial.mixArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR} mix_area, #{areaMaterial.materialName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} material_name FROM dual
) SELECT STOCK_DATE, MIX_AREA, material_name, ifnull(sum(STOCK_NUM), 0) STOCK_NUM, ifnull(sum(STOCK_WEIGHT), 0) STOCK_WEIGHT FROM T_LHFL_GLUE_STOCK WHERE DEL_FLAG= '0' AND STOCK_DATE = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) /*排程日期 要减1天，才是对应库存日期*/
AND (MIX_AREA, MATERIAL_NAME) IN (SELECT MIX_AREA, MATERIAL_NAME FROM temp_table)
GROUP BY STOCK_DATE, MIX_AREA, MATERIAL_NAME

WITH temp_table AS (
SELECT #{areaMaterial.mixArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR} mix_area, #{areaMaterial.materialName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} material_name FROM dual
) SELECT m.MATERIAL_NAME, /*物料名称*/ g.MIX_AREA, /*密炼区*/ ifnull(sum(g.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY), 0) as DAY_PLAN_QTY /*白班计划量*/ FROM T_GLUE_SCHEDULE_RESULT g INNER JOIN T_MIX_MACHINE e on g.MACHINE_CODE = e.MACHINE_CODE INNER JOIN T_MES_PMT_RECIPE r on g.glue = r.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME and g.MACHINE_CODE = r.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE and g.RECIPE_TYPE=r.RECIPE_TYPE and g.RECIPE_VERSION_ID=r.RECIPE_VERSION_ID /*根据物料名称、机台、配方类型、配方版本号关联*/ INNER JOIN T_MES_PMT_RECIPE_WEIGHT t on r.RECIPE_ID = t.FATHER_RECIPE_ID INNER JOIN T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL m on t.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE /*根据物料编码关联*/ WHERE g.SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) /*昨日排程*/
AND (g.mix_area, m.material_name) IN (SELECT MIX_AREA, MATERIAL_NAME FROM temp_table)
AND g.del_flag = '0' AND r.RECIPE_STATE = '1' /*配方状态: 再用*/ AND r.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' /*审核标志： 已审核*/ AND m.MAJOR_TYPE = '2' /*物料大类为：硫磺辅料*/ AND e.HAVE_SULFUR_STEELYARD = '0' /*密炼机上 没有硫磺秤*/ AND e.HAVE_MATERIAL_STEELYARD = '0' /*密炼机上 没有辅料秤*/ group by g.MIX_AREA, m.MATERIAL_NAME

WITH temp_table AS (
SELECT #{areaMaterial.mixArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR} mix_area, #{areaMaterial.materialName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} material_name FROM dual
) SELECT m.MATERIAL_NAME, /*物料名称*/ g.MIX_AREA, /*密炼区*/ ifnull(sum(FINISH_QTY), 0) as FINISH_QTY /*完成量*/ FROM T_GLUE_PART_FINISH f INNER JOIN T_GLUE_SCHEDULE_RESULT g on f.order_no = g.order_no INNER JOIN T_MES_PMT_RECIPE r on g.glue = r.RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME and g.MACHINE_CODE = r.RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE and g.RECIPE_TYPE=r.RECIPE_TYPE and g.RECIPE_VERSION_ID=r.RECIPE_VERSION_ID /*根据物料名称、机台、配方类型、配方版本号关联*/ INNER JOIN T_MES_PMT_RECIPE_WEIGHT t on r.RECIPE_ID = t.FATHER_RECIPE_ID INNER JOIN T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL m on t.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE /*根据物料编码关联*/ WHERE g.SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) /*昨日排程*/
AND (g.mix_area, m.material_name) IN (SELECT MIX_AREA, MATERIAL_NAME FROM temp_table)
AND g.del_flag = '0' AND r.RECIPE_STATE = '1' /*配方状态: 再用*/ AND r.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' /*审核标志： 已审核*/ AND m.MAJOR_TYPE = '2' /*物料大类为：硫磺辅料*/ group by g.MIX_AREA, m.MATERIAL_NAME
SELECT MATERIAL, ifnull(SAFE_STOCK, 0) SAFE_STOCK FROM T_LHFL_SAFE_STOCK WHERE MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'
